hypothesis: Human naive-vs-primed proximal genes share one-to-one orthologs with mouse P–M recurrent or same-contributor dual-reference proximal genes beyond conditional matching expectation. Support is not assumed.
mapping: Current 16092-row cross_overlap/ortholog_matched_features.tsv.gz; no historical selected integration table
mouse_definitions: Primary WPP series-matched recurrent P_M; threshold-specific. Dual requires current same-contributor PM and PS >=threshold in recurrent direction in both CIP and WOT; do not require recurrence on PS background.
human_definitions: For first four, require both N6-P7 and N8-P7 measurable; pooled mean or specified per-pair effect. Both-hN requires each effect <=-threshold. Same-library uses eligible N8-P8 only; no nonexistent N6-P6 assumed.
universe: Pair-specific common measurable one-to-one orthologs. Both mouse P_M routes measurable for recurrent target, both matched PMS routes measurable for dual target. Human complete contributors as above. Unmeasured orthologs excluded and accounted separately.
null: Independently shuffle binary proximal membership in human and mouse within species-specific strata, preserving both selected margins in every stratum. Fixed identity map, labels/shuffling conditional on measured assay covariates.
covariates: Human exact naive pair APA molecules/qualified metacells average endpoints and pairs, supported retained PAS count, exact primed or same-library P DWUI from stored usage@PAS-axis positions, proximal capacity reference-minus-min axis; both-hN uses same primed reference. Mouse frozen recurrence PM-study GEX and coverage/PAS median, baseline median and minimum proximal capacity across both measurable studies. For dual target use exact matched M and S reference for baseline and two-reference proximal capacity, while frozen recurrence expression/coverage remain documented proxy contributor summaries. Human GEX absent locally and not substituted by other states.
quantile_rules: Within each fixed test-specific measurable background, qcut with duplicate boundaries collapsed and no tie breaking; missing category -1. Same strata used for all thresholds where reference capacity is updated.
seed: 20261010 + first12SHA256(join namespace, human_label, mouse_target, threshold, model). Seed fixed by context.
statistics: unmatched hypergeometric mean and upper tail descriptively
analytic matched expectation sum of per-gene human_probability * mouse_probability
Monte Carlo matched count mean, 95% reference interval, excess and fold
mobility and exact preserved stratum margins
correction: For each model, primary .02 pooled tests against two mouse targets form BH2. Each model remaining 18 threshold/label/target tests are sensitivity BH18. Also BH20 per model and BH40 combined exploratory displayed. No switch of primary model after seeing results.
inference_scope: Conditional ortholog gene correspondence; fixed heterogeneous human hN libraries (one naive and one RSeT), one primed library; no biological replicate or species-causal inference. Fine model lacks human expression and may have low mobility; null-model disagreement must be surfaced.
validation: reconstruct all stored human DWUI deltas from PAS usage and weights
verify original recurrent rosters at both thresholds
verify .02 dual 207 proximal of222 overall by independent derivation
exact analytic null on toy enumeration
unmeasured genes cannot enter candidate or permutation
all output members measured and mapped uniquely

data_availability_amendment_before_stati.reason: Primary PAS_axes covers paired P/M genes only, so absolute full-native origin unavailable for naive-only genes. No overlap statistics produced before this amendment. All naive genes have current tandem eligibility native span.
data_availability_amendment_before_stati.reconstruction: Parse strand and cuts from exact PAS IDs, normalize signed cut distance by frozen full-native span; constant translation cancels in DWUI differences and supported-axis proximal movement. Verify every stored DWUI delta, and weight differences against available canonical axes.
data_availability_amendment_before_stati.baseline: All human genes uniformly use reference usage-weighted position relative to retained supported axis, scaled to that supported span. This is not absolute full-native baseline.
data_availability_amendment_before_stati.capacity: Reference-to-most-proximal-retained-PAS movement on frozen supported axis; no gene is removed by this proxy. Boolean capacity included only as stratum covariate. Observed deltas must satisfy mathematical attainable movement; an unexpected violation will stop verification, never silently drop an event.
data_availability_amendment_before_stati.null_and_families: No changes to independent shuffling, covariate count, quantile plan, correction families or draws.
